notes.title: HoloLAB Champions Now $0.99!
notes.notes:
[h1]A Special Message from HoloLAB Champions![/h1]

Greetings Contestants!

We know these are challenging times that we're all going through right now. One of the bigger disruptions include the learning institutions. How can new lab practitioners get the right vocabulary and processes down, while being quarantined in their homes? 

[b]We are slashing our usual $9.99 price to $0.99[/b] as long as the majority of students around the world are out of school. If you have a compatible virtual reality headset, becoming a contestant in [i]HoloLAB Champions[/i] has now become easier than ever.

See you in the HoloLAB!

notes.title: The LABstravaganza Comes to the Oculus Rift!
notes.notes:
Hello Geniuses!

Earl & Meyer are happy to announce that [i]HoloLAB Champions[/i] is officially available to play on the Oculus Rift. Mix, measure, and pour yourself to victory. Become a Lab Champion, today!

notes.title: The 'LABstravaganza' Is Live: Get HoloLAB Champions Today!
notes.notes:
Are YOU ready to prove what it takes to become a Champion in lab practice? [i]HoloLAB Champions[/i], the virtual reality lab practice game show, is now available on Steam for the HTC Vive. 

Pour, measure, and tare yourself to success through multiple mini-labs and final challenges. 

From the creators of [i] I Expect You To Die [/i] ([url= store.steampowered.com/app/587430/] Store page [/url]), [i] HoloLAB Champions [/i] is a highly polished VR experience that will keep you immersed in the HoloLAB, with hosts Earl & Meyer cheering you on. Take advantage of the 20% launch discount if you buy the game this week. It's a no brainer!

Become a Lab Champion!
